name: McpMemoryServer
description: Persistent Memory API Server with memory + local file tools for ChatGPT

tools.name: memory.read
tools.description: Read stored memory (preferences, facts, conversations) for the current session

tools.name: memory.write
tools.description: Write to persistent memory (preferences, facts, messages)

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Semantic search across all stored memory using vector similarity

tools.name: filesystem.read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the allowed directory

tools.name: filesystem.list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in a directory

tools.name: filesystem.search_files
tools.description: Search for files matching a pattern
